name: m_load_premium_feed
description: Premium staging to premium fact, enriched with policy product and region

transformations.name: SQ_premium_feed
transformations.sqlOverride: SELECT p.policy_number, d.product_code, d.region_code, p.premium_amount, p.effective_date FROM stg.premium_feed p JOIN dw.dim_policy d ON d.policy_number = p.policy_number WHERE p.effective_date BETWEEN '$$WindowStart' AND '$$WindowEnd'

transformations.name: TGT_premium_fact
transformations.postSQL: INSERT INTO dw.etl_log (proc_name, step, rows_affected) SELECT 'm_load_premium_feed', 'post', COUNT(*) FROM dw.premium_fact
